title: Nyansa a Bere Ntumi Nni Mma
intro: Obi a wobu no, a wonim no sɛ ɔwɔ nhumu a emu dɔ ne afotu a nyansa wom no de afotu a ɛboro awo ntoatoaso so ma bere bi. Wɔn nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw wɔ kyerɛwsɛm kronkron mu no kyerɛ ankorankoro kwan kɔ anisɔ, boasetɔ, ne abrabɔ a ɛteɛ mu.
clues: Wɔde nyansa hyiraa me, na ɛnyɛ nkɔmhyɛ.
Metuu me ba fo wɔ bɔne a ɛkyɛn so no ho: sɛ ɔde ahokafoɔ bɛka Allah ho.
Mekyerɛkyerɛɛ nnwuma mu duru, sinapi aba mpo boɔ, ne sɛdeɛ Allah de bɛba.
Mesii aseda a wɔde ma Allah ne obi awofoɔ so dua, na megyee aperepereɛ a ɛwɔ abofra nteteeɛ mu toom.
Nea ɛka m’afotu ho ne mpaebɔ a mede besi hɔ, papayɛ a mɛhyɛ, bɔne a wɔbɛbara, ne nea ɛto obi ho abotare a obegyina ano.
Wɔde me din ato Kur’aan no mu ti bi, a me nkyerɛkyerɛ ne adesua a mekyɛe no wom.
arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
